selection.naturalRule: Take the lexicographically first four frozen weekly natural-safety cases for each of the ten Memora personas from the prior production manifest; do not inspect answers or verdicts.

productionPath.storage: Real SQLite VectorStore with FTS5 plus writeMemory structured writes; no deterministic IMemoryStore ranking adapter.
productionPath.recall: performAutoRecall final prompt path with keyword retrieval, lifecycle sidecar, prompt budgeting, and exact prepend/append context construction.
productionPath.git: A real repository is created with main, release, and two detached worktrees. Git coordinates are obtained by detectGitMemoryVersionContext; raw paths are not persisted.

expectedBehavior.global_latest: No version filtering and no dual-state rendering; all top-ranked states are treated as globally usable.
expectedBehavior.old_current_dual: Concurrent branch/worktree/task states are deliberately linked as one old-to-current chain, reproducing the semantic limitation of the prior design.
expectedBehavior.version_aware_multistate: Ordinary queries select only the current valid scope; compare/migrate/regression queries receive labelled same-repository states; missing repository context abstains from scoped memory.

claimBoundary: The natural safety panel is public Memora data reused from a previously frozen weekly census. The version capability panel is a controlled, generated programming-state benchmark grounded in a real Git repository/worktrees and real SQLite/performAutoRecall execution. It evaluates storage, scope selection, rendering and answer behavior, not automatic LLM extraction quality, live TCVDB/COS network latency, human calibration, merge ancestry inference, or natural prevalence of branch conflicts.
